install.title: Install the app
install.desktop: On a computer you can skip this. Install the app on your phone.
install.iosBody: On iPhone, job alerts only work from the app on your Home Screen.
install.iosHow: How to add it to the Home Screen

ios.one: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
ios.two: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”, then “Add”.
ios.three: Open the app from your Home Screen and log in.

install.iosOld: Your iPhone needs iOS 16.4 or newer for alerts. Update it in Settings → General → Software Update.
install.androidBody: Install the app so alerts and directions open straight in it.
install.androidMenu: Open the browser menu (⋮) and tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

battery.title: Stop the phone from closing the app
battery.body: Some phones close apps to save battery, and alerts stop. Two minutes in settings fixes it.
battery.why: Follow the steps for your phone, then come back here.

xiaomi: Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Chrome.
Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
samsung: Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits.
Tap Never sleeping apps and add Chrome.
Make sure Chrome is not in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
oppo: Open Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimise battery use.
Find Chrome and choose Don't optimise.
In Settings → Apps → Chrome → Battery usage, allow background activity.
vivo: Open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management.
Find Chrome and allow high background power use.
other: Choose Unrestricted (or turn off battery optimisation for Chrome).
iphone: Keep Low Power Mode off while you're online.
Keep the app open on screen when you're waiting for jobs.
